comment: role.c plnamesuffix(): the rc's name "game" is in sysconf GENERICUSERS, so unixmain.c:198 clears it and asks "Who are you?". The answer "nethacker" is generic too but is kept, because the list is tested once, before the askname loop (1671-1687). role_init()'s call (1988) in newgame() then finds it generic and asks again, below the first prompt; "Una" starts the game.
